description: Discover the elegance of Haussmannian Paris in this sumptuous apartment of over 200 m², completely renovated, located a 10-minute walk from the Trocadero.It includes a large reception area of 120 m², three bedrooms and three bathrooms, including a master suite, a children's bedroom and an independent studio with a second kitchen and bathroom integrated into the apartment. A concierge welcomes you at any time for an exceptional Parisian experience.The spaceThe apartment consists of three bedrooms and sleeps up to 8 people: • 🛏️ Master suite with ensuite bathroom, combining privacy and comfort. • 👧 Children's room with 4 perfectly arranged beds. • 🏡 Independent studio integrated into the apartment, with private bathroom, toilet and kitchenette, ideal for a couple or a guest wishing more autonomy.Each space has been designed to offer the greatest comfort: high-end bedding, modern bathrooms, elegant decor and complete amenities.🛁 Amenities included • 🧴 Towels, sheets and soaps provided • 🚿 3 modern bathrooms • 🛏️ Sleeps 8 comfortably • 🍳 Equipped kitchen + independent kitchenette • 📶 High-speed Wi-Fi • 🏢 1st floor with elevatorGuest access🕓 Hours • Check-in: from 4 p.m. (flexible according to availability) • Check-out: before 11:00 a.m.⸻🤵 Guest accessThe reception is provided by a professional concierge, present at any time to open and accompany you upon check-in.Personalized service for a stay without constraints, living up to the standing of the place.Other things to note📍 LocationThe apartment is in a prestigious Haussmann building, in the immediate vicinity of: • Trocadero (10-minute walk) • Avenue Victor Hugo and Rue de Passy, known for their luxury boutiques and Parisian cafés • several subways and buses, offering quick access to all the iconic neighborhoods of ParisA
